The hymn we just heard sung by the choir speaks of promises which will become more important and more precious in the time ahead for all of us and for those we love.

2.eng: My message today is that the promises in that hymn are true. The lyrics, taken from the 41st chapter of Isaiah, have become a comforting guide for me, and they can be for you and for those you love in the trials which we individually face.

2.zhs: 我wǒ今jīn天tiān想xiǎng传chuán达dá的de信xìn息xī是shì，那nà首shǒu圣shèng诗shī中zhōng的de应yīng许xǔ是shì真zhēn实shí的de。这zhè段duàn出chū自zì以yǐ赛sài亚yà书shū第dì41章zhāng的de歌gē词cí，已yǐ经jīng成chéng为wéi安ān慰wèi我wǒ的de指zhǐ引yǐn，它tā也yě能néng在zài我wǒ们men每měi个gè人rén各gè自zì面miàn临lín考kǎo验yàn时shí，成chéng为wéi你nǐ和hé你nǐ所suǒ爱ài之zhī人rén的de安ān慰wèi与yǔ指zhǐ引yǐn。

12.eng: Those promises become more precious as we move through the challenges in our lives and in the lives of those we love. It is important to realize that the promise is not for the removal of challenges. My wise mother taught me that when I was a little boy. I had asked her, “Mother, why is life so hard?”

12.spa: Esas promesas se vuelven más preciadas a medida que afrontamos los desafíos de nuestra vida y de la vida de nuestros amados seres queridos.
